text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! That makes one crown down!
An honor truly befitting a King!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, milady!
Look at you go!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of that lady's daughter!
I'm looking forward to your next race too!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, everyone. Could you please stop calling me a 'lady' and all that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My name is King Halo!
Make sure you remember my full name before you go home!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That is proper etiquette toward a first-rate Umamusume!
Ohohoho!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... at this rate, it's not enough...!
In the Derby... no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, looks like it ended
with the young lady's victory.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't let it end like this.
It'd be so boring like this. So—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
That was an utterly flawless race!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If I keep this up, I'll definitely...!
choice_data_list: You can win the Japan Derby too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The once-in-a-lifetime stage
that everyone involved in the Twinkle Series longs for.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Whether you can make your mark with this single chance or not will determine how people evaluate you as an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If only I can take the Derby...
...I will, without fail—!!
